_note: Kindergarten "Draw and Write: Opinions, Facts, and Stories" (English literacy year, Part 12.3; types/_shared/draw-and-write-k.js). THE TEACHER READS every instruction, sentence and word. `pics`: [theme, picture], its kind (two of one kind never share a page) and the word printed under it. K-673: `pairs` (circle the one you like best: any choice is right), `pieces` (a kindergartner's opinion piece: topic sentence, opinion, reason; reFirst: the reason as printed before the opinion). K-674: `favTopics` (three a copy) with the reason words that fit each and the samples of each level, `reasonWords` (the level-1 box), `favModels` (the grey model: a topic never offered), `favBank` (the level-3 box). K-675: `factTopics` (an animal, a thing or a plant: facts true as printed, tags of facts of other topics that are true or arguable for it, the parts to label with the box measured for each part, its dot and the side its label stands on, words of parts it does not have, the box of the picture's ink and a 64 x 64 mask of it: 0 no ink, 1 some, 2 ink), `partInFact`. K-676: `teachTopics` (what each has and can do, its family), `hasWords`, `canWords`, `teachModels` (with their family), `teachBank`. K-677: `stories` (three and four sentences that follow one from another; the face that is right). K-678: `moments` with the samples, `momentModels`, `momentBank`. K-679: `asks` (a piece, the question, an answer of each kind; `same` says again what the piece says), `askQ`. K-680: `chairQuestions` (level 1 circles one), `chairExamples` (the worked example of each copy, with the samples of each level). `modelOnly`: what the notes model with (on no page); `noteWords`: the fact words of the note model of each lesson (no sample of the lesson holds one). `banned`: words no page prints.

stories.title: The Ladybug
stories.name: Mia
s3: A ladybug landed on my hand.
Then it flew up into the sky.
I watched it fly away and smiled.
s4: A ladybug landed on my hand.
It walked to the tip of my finger.
From my finger, it flew up into the sky.
I watched it fly away and smiled.

stories.title: My Hat
stories.name: Ben
s3: I could not find my hat after recess.
I looked under the slide and found it.
I smiled and put it on my head.
s4: I could not find my hat after recess.
I looked for it all over the playground.
At last, I found it under the slide.
I smiled and put it on my head.

stories.title: The Bee
stories.name: Ana
s3: A bee buzzed near my face at recess.
I jumped up and ran to my teacher.
I held her hand until the bee flew away.
s4: A bee buzzed near my face at recess.
Then it buzzed right by my nose.
I jumped up and ran to my teacher.
I held her hand until the bee flew away.

stories.title: My Shoe
stories.name: Omar
s3: My shoe came untied in the hall.
I sat down and tied it all by myself.
Then I clapped for myself!
s4: My shoe came untied in the hall.
I sat down on the bench.
On the bench, I tied it all by myself.
Then I clapped for myself!

stories.title: The Sticker
stories.name: Kim
s3: I put all the books back on the shelf.
My teacher saw what I did.
She gave me a sticker, and I smiled.
s4: Books were all over the rug.
I put all the books back on the shelf.
My teacher saw what I did.
She gave me a sticker, and I smiled.

stories.title: Spilled Water
stories.name: Eli
s3: I carried a cup of water to my table.
I tripped, and the water spilled on my picture.
My picture was all wet, and I cried.
s4: I carried a cup of water to my table.
On the way, I tripped on my shoelace.
The water spilled on my picture.
My picture was all wet, and I cried.

stories.title: The Wind
stories.name: Zara
s3: I drew a picture outside at recess.
The wind blew my paper over the fence.
I could not get it back, so I stomped my feet.
s4: I drew a picture outside at recess.
A big wind blew my paper away.
It flew over the fence.
I could not get it back, so I stomped my feet.

stories.title: The Bubble
stories.name: Raj
s3: I dipped my wand in the soap.
I blew a big bubble.
When it floated up high, I jumped for joy.
s4: I dipped my wand in the soap.
I blew a big bubble.
It got bigger and bigger.
When it floated up high, I jumped for joy.

stories.title: My Friend Was Sick
stories.name: Nia
s3: My best friend was sick and stayed home.
At lunch, I had no one to sit with.
I sat by myself and cried.
s4: My best friend was sick.
So she had to stay home from school.
At lunch, I had no one to sit with.
I sat by myself and cried.

stories.title: The Big Dog
stories.name: Luis
s3: We walked by the fence at recess.
A big dog on the other side barked at us.
I jumped back and grabbed my teacher’s hand.
s4: We walked by the fence at recess.
A big dog ran up on the other side.
It barked and barked at us.
I jumped back and grabbed my teacher’s hand.

stories.title: My Turn
stories.name: Jay
s3: I waited in line for the swing.
A big kid cut in and took my turn.
I crossed my arms and stomped my foot.
s4: I waited in line for the swing.
At last, it was almost my turn.
Then a big kid cut in front of me.
I crossed my arms and stomped my foot.

I yelped and jumped back.
s4: It was time to go outside.

stories.title: Our Song
stories.name: Theo

I took a bow and grinned from ear to ear.
s4: Our class stood up on the stage.

stories.title: The Lost Crayon
stories.name: Dev
